part.text:
Implemented the negative-integer fix.

- `include/fmt/format.h`: `group_digits` now uses `make_write_int_arg` to apply the sign/prefix while grouping the absolute value.
- `include/fmt/color.h`: fixed a pre-existing template deduction build error (`nullptr` → typed null pointer) so the full test suite compiles.

`format-test` passes all 123 tests, including the negative `group_digits` cases. Full `ctest` passes 18/20; the two remaining failures are pre-existing chrono timezone/refactor failures unrelated to this change.
